اهتلكت (form VIII)
# اِهْتَلَكْتُ (ihtalaktu) /ih.ta.lak.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اِهْتَلَكْتَ (ihtalakta) /ih.ta.lak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اِهْتَلَكْتِ (ihtalakti) /ih.ta.lak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اِهْتَلَكَتْ (ihtalakat) /ih.ta.la.kat/: third-perso
